RAY_KW_DEPTH.title: Depth
RAY_KW_DEPTH.description: A resource that builds up during a combat and resets each fight. Higher is stronger, but above 50 you can no longer summon Sand Beasts.
RAY_KW_AMMO.title: Ammo
RAY_KW_AMMO.description: A per-combat resource, maximum {AmmoCap}. Spent or refilled by related cards; more Ammo makes some cards hit harder.
RAY_KW_BEAST.title: Sand Beast
RAY_KW_BEAST.description: A summon, up to 2 at a time. It marks an enemy; each mark makes that enemy take 10% more attack damage.
